excerpts.content:
We have just launched the **Plataberget** 🐻‍❄️ testnet (also known as glamsterdam-devnet-8)! 🎉

Genesis is at <t:1786622400:F> (<t:1786622400:R>). The testnet is open to the public.

We plan to do the **Glamsterdam network upgrade at epoch 1536** — <t:1787212224:F> (<t:1787212224:R>). If you want to test the fork transition, please aim to have your validators and builders onboarded before that date. Shortly after the fork, the EIP-8261 gas limit schedule steps the network from 60M to 200M gas at epoch 1566 (<t:1787223744:t>) - using the optional EIP 8261 scheduling mechanism. 

- Config: https://github.com/ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-8
- Spec sheet: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/glamsterdam-devnet-8
- Explorer: https://dora.plataberget.ethpandaops.io
- Faucet: https://faucet.plataberget.ethpandaops.io
- Checkpoint sync: https://checkpoint-sync.plataberget.ethpandaops.io

Blog post announcement coming soon.
